# release-note-indent

indentBody(text, prefix) accepts strings using LF line endings. Add prefix to each nonempty line; leave empty lines empty, including the empty segment after a final LF. A line containing spaces is nonempty and must be prefixed. Preserve all LF characters. Empty input returns an empty string.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
